svg.title: MarkeTech: from a commit to production
svg.desc: Panel A: work is committed on develop, then merged into main with git merge --no-ff. The workflow Test and publish images runs on every push to develop or main. Panel B: the job test sets up Python 3.13 and runs python manage.py test with config.settings.dev; the job build needs test and runs twice, for backend and frontend: it logs in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, computes the tags sha-<commit> and latest (default branch only), builds the image and pushes it only from main. Every action is pinned to a full commit SHA. Panel C: the public images ghcr.io/danielgarcia85/marketech-backend and marketech-frontend. Panel D: the production server pulls new images every two minutes and recreates the changed containers; it never builds; IMAGE_TAG in .env can pin a version for a rollback; migrations run when the backend starts (entrypoint.sh).
svg.text: MarkeTech: from a commit to production
A push on develop tests and builds. A push on main also publishes the two images, which production then runs. Follow the numbers 1 to 7.
Real files of the repository: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, backend/entrypoint.sh (main, 30.10.2026).
GitHub-hosted runners, created for the run

svg.text: --no-ff always creates a merge commit on main, even when a fast-forward was possible:
each merge stays visible in the history, and its push starts the run that publishes.

g.text: From develop, nothing reaches the registry
The two images are built (proof that they still build), then discarded: push is false outside main. "latest" is only given on the
default branch, main, so it always designates the most recent image of main.

text.font-family: Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Migrations run when the backend starts
backend/entrypoint.sh brings the database schema up to date each time a backend container starts, before Daphne (set -e: never on a
half-prepared application). IMAGE_TAG=latest follows main; IMAGE_TAG=sha-<7 chars> stays on that version until it is changed back.
